newsitem.title: USA: US Plains feedlot cattle bid $63/no sales-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains feedlot cattle bid $63/no sales-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle bids at $63.00 per cwt early Thursday were passed by owners pricing cattle at $64.00, feedlot sources said.
Sales Wednesday were brisk at $64.00 early, but turned slow by midday when packers pulled bids back to $63.00 and owners resisted selling further cattle, the sources said.
AT $64.00, some cattle feeders slipped into unprofitable territory and at $63.00 nearly all owners would lose money on cattle sold, several feedlot managers said.
Many of the cattle bought this week reportedly were being shipped as early as two days later, sources said.
